findings.message: The tini package has been removed from stage-packages, but the enabled service command depends on /usr/bin/tini. Evidence confirms the proposed filesystem contains no /usr/bin/tini, symlink, or alternative tini binary; no transitive dependency provides it. The service will fail at startup. Restore tini to stage-packages or confirm in the PR that this removal is intentional and the command has been updated.

summary: Source bump (commit 000000000000...000d) removes tini from app part stage-packages. Service command and all other recipe elements unchanged. Proposed filesystem lacks required /usr/bin/tini binary.
